author: unknown
content:
anyone else feel like snabbit just...dehumanises people (their workers)?
for context, my mother booked a slot from my phone today and i was js checking out the interface for the first time... and wtf is this? at first i thought it was rather a decent incentive, and helps people find employment, but this? they're working for us, in our home, why would we have to... manually allow this? these are basic human rights, dawg, its so weird to include such slighting stuff in your interface. i mean as precaution i get it, there are stealing incidents and so on, but that's on us to look after and be wary of, well its controversial but i really hate how this is a thing in the interface.
